notes.title: Big Winter Update is here!
notes.content:
In this exciting update to [b]Holy Stick![/b], we've implemented probably one of the most anticipated features by our community, one that completely changes the game... [b]Bots![/b] 🤖

You can now add AI enemies to your match, as well as create a game via a brand new option -[b] "Quick Match"[/b]. Just straight up jump into the game! 😎 Of course, we have [b]Christmas features[/b] too! In the form of [b]Christmas costumes[/b] and [b]winter maps![/b] 🎁🎄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40184871/ca6e8294eb7bb63405b96fc88a59388207f27e07.png[/img]

We have one more information. This is the last big update to Holy Stick! you'll be getting. But it's not the last time you'll be hearing from us!

It's been a crazy half-year of after-hours development, and we've decided that this update will be the last to Holy Stick!, it's probably the best time to do so - the game state is great right now, and AI enemies will add a new layer for you to enjoy. 

[b]We've learned much, we've new ideas, and we'll be working still - you will be hearing from us soon, that's sure! 🦾[/b]

Follow us on our Social Media to stay informed:
[url=https://www.facebook.com/wearealwaystoolate][b]Facebook[/b][/url] 🌍
[url=https://twitter.com/alwaystoolatehq][b]Twitter:[/b][/url] 🐤
[url=https://www.instagram.com/holystickgame/][b]Instagram:[/b][/url] 📸
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@alwaystoolatehq][b]Tiktok:[/b] [/url] 📱

To wrap things up - we wish you all a Happy Christmas. Enjoy this amazing time of the year, and enjoy Holy Stick! 👋🏻

Cheers,
Always Too Late Team

notes.title: Holy Stick! Halloween update is live!
notes.content:
Hello fellow Sticks, 🔥

Thanks for supporting us, we’re very thankful for sticking with us! (pun intended) - and now to the point - We have something for you…

👻🎃 It’s Halloween time! 🎃👻

It’s spooky time! We haven’t got candies, but we’ve got something else - very fun too!  With this Halloween Update, we’re bringing some new cool features for you!

New halloween-themed costumes and brand new gamemode - Zombies!

Check it out now, and share screenshots on our Discord, we hope you’ll have fun! :)

Keep calm and scare on!
Always Too Late Team 🔥

notes.title: Check out the game modes in Holy Stick!
notes.content:
[h2]Check out our awesome game modes![/h2]

We're thrilled to share some amazing news about the fantastic mods that have been incorporated into the game so far. Did You know that there are currently 12 different game modes in Holy Stick? Well, now you do! 🫢

🚀 Below you will find a short list of mods present in the game! 🚀

⭐ [b]Team Deathmatch[/b] - Defeat the members of the opposing team to get points. 

⭐ [b]Deathmatch[/b] - Defeat other stickmen to get points. 

⭐ [b]Capture The Flag[/b] - Steal the opposing team’s flag from their base, while preventing them from taking yours.

⭐ [b]Keep The Flag[/b] - Find the flag and keep it with you as long as you can to get points.

⭐ [b]Take The Flag[/b] - Find the flag and bring it to your team’s base to get points.

⭐ [b]Last Team Standing [/b]- Take out the entire enemy team to get a point. You get only one life per round!

⭐ [b]Last Stick Standing[/b] - Take out all other stickmen to get a point. You get only one life per round!

⭐ [b]Team Gungame[/b] - All stickmen start with the same weapon. Defeat the members of the opposing team to get points and receive different weapons.

⭐ [b]Gungame [/b]- All stickmen start with the same weapon. Defeat other stickmen to get points and receive different weapons.

⭐ [b]Tag[/b] - A classic game of tag. The longer you stay not tagged, the more points you get.

⭐ [b]Sniper Tag [/b]- A classic game of tag with a sniping twist. The longer you stay not tagged, the more points you get. 

⭐ [b]Zombie [/b]- When you’re a zombie, infect healthy players by hitting them to get points. When you’re healthy, defeat zombies for points. Zombies can’t pick up weapons and are quite slow, but they’ve got extra durability.

[b]Don't miss out on the excitement, try out the 12 game mods! 🔥[/b]

❓ Now the best part!  - We want to hear from YOU! What is your favorite game mode and what kind of game modes would you love to see in the future? Your input is invaluable, and we're eager to shape the game's future together! 🫡

May your sticks stay holy and your battles be epic! 🥢
[b]
🌴 Remember to follow us on our socials! [/b]▶ https://linktr.ee/holy.stick

Cheers,
The Holy Stick team! 🤩

notes.title: New skins and maps!
notes.content:
[h2]30 days left until the release! ⏳
[/h2]The countdown is on! The release of our game is just around the corner, and we are in full throttle, continuously injecting fresh content into our sticky universe! 🚀
Prepare yourselves as we unveil a thrilling new map, destined to deliver an unforgettable experience. Get ready to unleash your skills, outsmart your opponents, and make epic outplays on a new battleground! 🗺️🎮

But wait, that’s not all my fellow stickmen enjoyers! We've gone the extra mile by dropping new skins that will let you unleash your unique style like never before. Get ready to dominate the battlefield in epic fashion with these eye-catching skins! 💅✨

The premiere is just around the corner, folks, so mark your calendars for the 18th of August because that's when the real action begins... 🔥
🌴[b] Remember to follow us on our socials! [/b]▶ https://linktr.ee/holy.stick


Cheers,
The Holy Stick team! 🤩
